# hpa-gita-chapter16-daivi-asuri-kernel-quality-model

**Scope(s):** THEORY-LEVEL · **Row count:** 8 ·
**Lifecycle (candidate):** ACTIVE · **Layer (provisional):** LAYER-UNRESOLVED
**Notations:** `B:K x O x C -> {Permit,Reject,Defer}`; `F_t=(ignorance,ego,anger,greed,attachment,uncontrolled desire)`; `Verify(P,E) -> {top,bot,?}`
**Aliases:** "Chapter 16 divine vs demoniac qualities reading"; "kernel quality model / anti-pattern failure vector"
**Candidate group membership (NOT an identity claim):**
- G0503: links this to `hpa-buddhi-discrimination-second-pass` — explicit agent-stated uncertainty: 'hpa-gita-chapter16-daivi-asuri-kernel-quality-model' POSSIBLY relates to 'hpa-buddhi-discrimination-second-pass' (batch B0054). Note: Disciplined hpa reading of Gita Chapter 16 (divine vs demoniac qualities) treated as a candidate source of KERNEL CONTROL SEMANTICS, not new primitives. Explicitly rejects modeling the 26 divine qualities (or Sastra/Dharma=Governance, or the Gita establishing the algebra) as primitives/architecture, but proposes a kernel quality model (26-item Gita-term-to-KnowledgeOS-property table) and its corresponding anti-pattern failure vector F_t. Central contributions: a closed epistemic self-reinforcement failure loop explaining 'kernel can become its own enemy'; a Kama/Krodha/Lobha Zero-lens contamination taxonomy (goal contamination, contradiction rejection, unpurified accumulation); Zero broadened from a null-space detector to an epistemic-defect detector; a Buddhi-as-gatekeeper operator B:KxOxC->{Permit,Reject,Defer} preceding delta; a Verify(P,E)->{top,bot,?} operator with the principle ?->Zero->Gap (Zero as Buddhi correctly refusing to pretend unresolved knowledge is resolved); and a final formal operator hypothesis set {Omega,M,B,Q,V,Z,delta}.
- G0505: links this to `hpa-gita-chapter16-combined-quality-control-pathology-model` — explicit agent-stated uncertainty: 'hpa-gita-chapter16-combined-quality-control-pathology-model' POSSIBLY relates to 'hpa-gita-chapter16-daivi-asuri-kernel-quality-model' (batch B0054). Note: A second, distinct hpa treatment of Chapter 16 combined with the full Chapters 10-15 model (companion to S2241, which read Ch16 alone): reframes daivi/asuri not as virtue/vice but as two classes of epistemic OPERATING BEHAVIOUR (healthy vs pathological transformation). Contributes a kernel pathology model distinguishing healthy (Evidence->Discrimination->Qualification->Knowledge) from distorted (Desire->Selection->Rationalization->False Knowledge) transformation pipelines; reframes Zero as the kernels ability to represent the boundary between knowledge and non-knowledge (false certainty = the kernel believing unknown=known, the near-opposite of Zero); introduces a transformation-quality functional Q_B(K_t,K_{t+1}); makes purification explicitly non-monotonic (a legitimate epistemic improvement can involve decreasing confidence); proposes an invariant against unjustified certainty (U(x)->C(x) requires sufficient justification); and reinforces Buddhi(discrimination) != Governance(legitimate constraint over action) as a restatement of Guidance!=Authority. Proposes final kernel tuple K_kernel=(K_t,B_t,Z_t,Q_t,delta_t).
